prompt:
Look at the time-series table in the image. It shows a card-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, a rounded outer frame, and a shaded header row. Read the named row over time and report the requested integer result. Subtract the 2022 value from the 2023 value for row Tera. What is the result?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] ordered as [start-year cell, end-year cell].
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":-4}
